def VTask.leastOfBdd {P : ℤ → Prop} [DecidablePred P] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ z, P z → b ≤ z) (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) : { lb // P lb ∧ ∀ z, P z → lb ≤ z } := 
  let Q (n : Nat) := P (b + n)
  have hexists : ∃ n, Q n := by 
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Hinh
    have hz_ge_b : b ≤ z := Hb z hz
    let m := Nat.ofSub hz_ge_b
    have h_eq : b + m = z := Nat.ofSub_eq_of_le hz_ge_b
    rw [h_eq] at hz 
    exact ⟨m, hz⟩
  let n_min : Nat := Nat.find hexists
  let lb : ℤ := b + n_min
  have h_p_lb : P lb := by 
    have h_q : Q n_min := Nat.find_spec hexists
    exact h_q
  have h_min : ∀ z, P z → lb ≤ z := by 
    intro z hz_p
    have hz_ge_b' : b ≤ z := Hb z hz_p
    let m' := Nat.ofSub hz_ge_b'
    have h_eq' : b + m' = z := Nat.ofSub_eq_of_le hz_ge_b'
    have h_q' : Q m' := by 
      rw [h_eq']
      exact hz_p
    have h_le : n_min ≤ m' := Nat.find_min hexists h_q'
    have h_lb_le_z : lb ≤ z := by 
      rw [lb, h_eq']
      apply Int.add_le_add_right
      exact h_le
    exact h_lb_le_z
  ⟨lb, ⟨h_p_lb, h_min⟩⟩
